sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "club"."Region" AS g, AVG((CAST("player"."Tries" AS REAL) / "player"."Points")) AS m1 FROM "player" JOIN "club" ON "club"."Club_ID" = "player"."Club_ID" GROUP BY "club"."Region"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
why: tries scored / points scored: the catalogue declares tries scored part of points scored
average of tries scored per points scored per club.Region
index against the all average of average of tries scored per points scored (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "club"."Region" AS g, AVG("player"."Points") AS m1, SUM(("player"."Apps" - "player"."Tries")) AS m2 FROM "player" JOIN "club" ON "club"."Club_ID" = "player"."Club_ID" GROUP BY "club"."Region"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
why: average of points scored per club.Region
appearances - tries scored: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one player
total of appearances minus tries scored per club.Region (additive)
share of the all total of total of appearances minus tries scored (all level)
